issues.message: Headline is severely clipped at the right canvas edge. Visible text reads 'BUY ETFs COM' — the remainder (likely 'COMMISSION FREE' or similar) is cut off, making the core message unreadable.
CTA pill and label are clipped by the right canvas edge. Visible text reads 'START' with what appears to be 'INV…' bleeding off-canvas; the pill shape is also truncated.
CTA label is incomplete due to right-edge clipping; users cannot read the full call to action.
Because both headline and CTA are truncated, the intended reading order collapses — the eye lands on partial words rather than a clear message-then-action flow.
CTA pill has zero right-edge padding (it extends past the canvas), violating the ≥16px breathing-room guideline.
Variant appears nearly identical to the source, including replicating the same clipping problems present in the source render. Composition, palette, and typography are preserved.

notes: The variant faithfully mirrors the source but inherits/reproduces critical right-edge clipping on both the headline and CTA. Not shippable in this state regardless of source fidelity.
